parameters.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT country_code, year, value
  FROM datos_comercio
  WHERE indicator = $2
),
ult AS (
  SELECT MAX(year) AS anio FROM base
),
rank_ult AS (
  SELECT b.country_code, b.value,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.value DESC) AS puesto,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM base b, ult
  WHERE b.year = ult.anio
),
prev AS (
  SELECT b.value
  FROM base b, ult
  WHERE b.country_code = $1 AND b.year = ult.anio - 1
),
resumen AS (
  SELECT (SELECT anio FROM ult) AS anio,
         r.value AS valor,
         r.puesto,
         r.total,
         r.value - (SELECT value FROM prev) AS variacion
  FROM rank_ult r
  WHERE r.country_code = $1
)
INSERT INTO solicitudes (pais, indicador, estado, resumen)
SELECT $3::text,
       $4::text,
       'pendiente',
       'En ' || anio || ', ' || $3::text || ' registró ' || ROUND(valor, 1)
         || ' en ' || $4::text || ', puesto ' || puesto || ' de ' || total
         || '. Variación frente al año anterior: ' || ROUND(variacion, 1)
FROM resumen
RETURNING id, pais, indicador, estado, resumen, creado_en;
